def test_rounded_avg():

    assert rounded_avg(1, 5) == "0b11"          # avg = 3 -> 0b11
    assert rounded_avg(7, 13) == "0b1010"       # avg = 10 -> 0b1010
    assert rounded_avg(10, 10) == "0b1010"      # single element: avg = 10
    assert rounded_avg(0, 0) == "0b0"           # single element: avg = 0

    # Case requiring rounding (.5 triggers banker's rounding in Python)
    assert rounded_avg(20, 33) == "0b11010"     # avg = 26.5 -> round -> 26 -> 0b11010

    # Invalid range: m < n returns -1
    assert rounded_avg(5, 4) == -1
    assert rounded_avg(-3, -5) == -1

    # Negative ranges
    assert rounded_avg(-5, -5) == "-0b101"      # avg = -5
    assert rounded_avg(-3, 3) == "0b0"          # avg = 0
